answer.rationale: The incumbent cannot meet the mandated 18% reduction and the low-cost vendor’s quote does. Verify the low-cost vendor’s prior onboarding evidence and the incumbent’s demonstrated continuity record before committing, because the 14-day expiry and 94% line utilization make any delivery disruption disproportionately costly. If switching proceeds, constrain it to a guarded transition with explicit delivery protections rather than assuming the prior quick onboarding proves current capacity performance.
